summary: Iteration 21 - Bug Fixes Testing Complete. All backend APIs (12/12 tests passed) and frontend UI components working correctly. Tested: AdminClasses create/edit/delete with all fields, AdminStaff gym selector for Super Admin, AdminSettings Mi Plan SaaS section, AdminMembers email history modal, and ErrorBoundary component.
passed_tests: GET /api/classes returns classes with all fields (id, name, gym_id, max_capacity, duration_minutes, class_type, start_time, end_time, days_of_week, trainer)
POST /api/classes creates class with all fields (name, description, trainer_id, max_capacity, duration_minutes, class_type, recurring, days_of_week, start_time, end_time, start_date, end_date)
PUT /api/classes/{id} updates class with start_time, end_time, start_date, end_date, days_of_week
DELETE /api/classes/{id} removes class from active list
GET /api/gyms returns list of gyms for super admin
POST /api/staff with gym_id works for super admin
GET /api/trainers returns trainers list
GET /api/saas/my-subscription returns subscription info with plan details
GET /api/saas/available-plans returns available SaaS plans
GET /api/emails/member/{id} returns email history
POST /api/trainers with gym_id creates trainer for super admin
POST /api/classes with trainer_id returns class with trainer info
AdminClasses: 'Nueva Clase' button opens create modal with all fields
AdminClasses: Create class form has name, description, trainer, type, capacity, duration, recurring checkbox, days of week, start/end times, start/end dates
AdminClasses: Class card shows 3-dot menu on hover with 'Editar' and 'Eliminar' options
AdminClasses: Edit modal opens with title 'Editar Clase' and pre-populated fields
AdminClasses: Edit modal has 'Actualizar Clase' button
AdminStaff: Super Admin sees 'Gimnasio' dropdown in create staff modal
AdminStaff: Gym dropdown shows all available gyms (10 gyms found)
AdminSettings: 'Mi Plan SaaS' section visible for Gym Admin
AdminSettings: Shows plan name 'Plan Inicial' with price '29.99 EUR/mes'
AdminSettings: Shows capacity bar '11 / 100' members
AdminSettings: Shows 12 feature items with included/not included indicators
AdminSettings: Has 'Cambiar Plan' button
AdminMembers: Dropdown menu has 'Emails' option
AdminMembers: Email history modal opens with member name
AdminMembers: Modal shows 'No hay emails enviados a este socio' when empty
ErrorBoundary: Component exists at /app/frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.js
ErrorBoundary: Wraps AdminRoute children in App.js
ErrorBoundary: Wraps MemberRoute children in App.js
ErrorBoundary: Has data-testid='error-boundary-reload' button
critical_code_review_comments: AdminClasses.js: Complete rewrite with full CRUD support - create, edit, delete classes with all fields (start_time, end_time, start_date, end_date, days_of_week, recurring)
AdminClasses.js: Uses DropdownMenu with Editar/Eliminar options on class cards
AdminClasses.js: Edit modal correctly pre-populates all fields from existing class data
AdminStaff.js: Super Admin gym selector properly fetches gyms via fetchGyms() and shows in create modal
AdminStaff.js: Uses selectedGymId state to track selected gym for staff creation
AdminSettings.js: MiPlanSection component shows plan details, capacity bar, and feature list
AdminSettings.js: SAAS_FEATURES array defines all 12 feature flags with icons
AdminMembers.js: handleOpenEmails function fetches email history via getMemberEmails API
AdminMembers.js: Email modal shows list with subject, sent_at, status, email_type
ErrorBoundary.js: Proper React class component with getDerivedStateFromError and componentDidCatch
App.js: ErrorBoundary wraps children in both AdminRoute and MemberRoute components
seed_data_creation: Created test classes during testing (TEST_Yoga_Matutino, TEST_Class_*, etc.) - these are cleaned up by backend tests
